notes.title: Escape Legacy : Ancient Scrolls - Update v1.15
notes.content:
New Update Available!

- Improved accuracy when Targeting/Picking items

We hope this update will make Escape Legacy a better experience!

..and as always enjoy Escaping!  :-)

notes.title: Escape Legacy : Ancient Scrolls - Update v1.1
notes.content:
Hello! We read listen and watch every video you make on our game and we are excited that you like it! That's why we take into account every issue each one of you has and we take steps to make Escape Legacy more suitable for everyone!

PatchNotes v1.1 :

- 48 New Achievements!!!
 +30 for Level Completion
 +18 for Gem Collecting 
-Corrected Invert Mouse control for Y-Axis only
-Character will walk at a steady pace, to Run Hold - Left Shift
-Crouch animations made more smooth

Thank you for Escaping!  :-)
